queue_scope: 204 source records seed, physical identity overlaps UNKNOWN; discover and register additional families through planner index changes
unit_of_work: Exactly one field_id and one stated research question per iteration; for a live numeric intervention only one field altered and one target value per trial, with other covariates controlled.
state_machine_note: These are per-field research statuses, not OS run lifecycle enums.
deterministic_field_order: SWEEP_1 traverse all queue entries in declared field order; never silently omit any unknown offset. SWEEP_2+ choose fields by highest decision risk and weakest verified evidence, with last-attempted fairness and explicit priority rationale.
one_iteration: Load exact GitHub queue source SHA, latest task checkpoint and last ledger entry; refuse overwriting user local changes
Select next field_id, record a single evidence question and observable outcome before any action
Inspect existing REA/Native project evidence for this field (read-only by default); if runtime operation is protected, record blocker instead of executing
Perform only explicitly permitted static/read-only proof or authorized bounded test; capture timestamp, game mode and independent native verification grade
Run item-level verification and required negative case; record independent original evidence refs, unmeasured effects as UNKNOWN
Append field record/ledger checkpoint with next_field_id, pass number and actual repository HEAD; same branch only
Advance cursor; do not remain on blocked field in SWEEP_1; loop within same task at next field

per_field_failure_policy.after_unproductive_attempt: mark BLOCKED_FIELD/UNKNOWN with cause and next specific evidence; advance cursor

improvement_loop.sweep_1_goal: Every seed field attempted exactly once; output a field record or truthful UNKNOWN/BLOCKED including unique ID. Completeness of inventory is not effect proof.
improvement_loop.sweep_n_goal: Target the weakest critical unresolved field/interaction; record which gap or confidence bound improved; one field and one evidence claim per iteration.
improvement_metric: new primary source link accurately matches claim
native identity consumer path independently traced
numeric trial readback for one value gained with permission
decision method honestly downgraded or strengthened
improvement_loop.no_improvement: If a full post-baseline sweep has no new truthful evidence or test capability and no in-scope method remains, stop research wave as PARTIAL; never fabricate progress.
improvement_loop.restart: Reload current task Run/ledger and recover exact cursor; no automatic background work.

reviewed_ending: One frozen per-stream evidence set and completion pointer with accurate PARTIAL/REVIEW_READY scope; both streams later jointly audited. Unknown values remain open.

future_handoff.cross_stream_truth: GPT sources cannot upgrade Gemini Native grade; Gemini static REA map cannot prove numeric effect without real experiments
future_handoff.write_ownership: Never write into other stream Run or overwrite source catalog
